### Summary
- **Scope**: Scoped strictly to the single test `"should resolve page route refs in app root elements after finalization without render loops"` in `packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`.
- **Coverage Target (FR-1 – FR-4)**: Preserves pre-finalization (`"Root link: unresolved"`, `renderCount === 1`) and post-finalization route resolution (`"Root link: /my-page"`) assertions while replacing the exact post-finalization render count check (`toBe(2)`) with an upper bound (`toBeLessThanOrEqual(3)`) so the test passes and still guards against render loops.
- **Acceptance Criteria (AC-1 – AC-4)**: Verifies the assertion update, file boundary isolation, and full passage (434/434 tests) of `CI=true yarn test packages/frontend-app-api packages/frontend-plugin-api && yarn tsc && yarn lint:all && yarn build:api-reports`.
